nodes.label: Existing Graph Fast Path
nodes.rationale: Natural-language codebase questions should query an existing graph immediately instead of repeating detection and extraction.

nodes.label: Graphify Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Edges must not be invented, uncertainty must remain visible, costs and cohesion must be shown, and large visualizations require warning.

nodes.label: Evidence Confidence Model
nodes.rationale: Explicit source relationships are EXTRACTED, interpretation is INFERRED at discrete scores, and unresolved uncertainty is retained as AMBIGUOUS.

nodes.label: Deterministic Path-Derived Node IDs
nodes.rationale: IDs retain every repository-relative path segment so AST and semantic extraction do not create ghost duplicates.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: Traversal terms are selected only from actual graph labels to bridge vocabulary mismatches without inventing search tokens.

nodes.label: Replace on Re-Extract
nodes.rationale: Changed sources are replaced during merge while pruning is reserved for genuinely deleted files, preventing stale and duplicate nodes.

nodes.label: Graph-First Codebase Workflow
nodes.rationale: Existing scoped graph queries should precede broad source browsing, and code modifications should be followed by an incremental graph update.

nodes.label: Crypto Release Stages
nodes.rationale: Phase A must emit the versioned legacy envelope before later releases enable GCM and Argon2 writes, while all stages retain compatible readers.

nodes.label: Minimized Argon2 Vendor Surface
nodes.rationale: Only the portable public implementation, threading abstraction, BLAKE2b, and license are vendored; generators, CLI, tests, and x86 optimized sources are excluded.

nodes.label: Local Crypto Threat Model
nodes.rationale: The primary target is offline extraction of app-private files; unlocked-process compromise, endpoint compromise, and OS SMS metadata are outside scope.

nodes.label: Additive Versioned Crypto Migration
nodes.rationale: Algorithms are never swapped in place; new formats and derived keys are introduced additively while legacy readers remain available.

nodes.label: Identity MAC Compatibility Exception
nodes.rationale: The bare identity HMAC has no envelope discriminator and remains scoped to HMAC-SHA1 until it receives its own versioned schema and dual verifier.

nodes.label: Legacy PBKDF1 Wrapper Retirement
nodes.rationale: Argon2 does not improve effective offline resistance while the same root remains attackable through a retained PBKDF1 wrapper.

nodes.label: Deferred SQLCipher Migration
nodes.rationale: Whole-database re-encryption provides metadata protection but is deferred because it has the highest migration and interruption risk.

nodes.label: Staged Local Crypto Rollout
nodes.rationale: A Phase A-only release must qualify framing before GCM, Argon2, wrapper retirement, and Keystore protection advance through later releases.
